events.note: Horizons APmag reaches its least value, -4.804, on a plateau from 23 to 25 September at three-decimal precision; a parabolic fit to ten-minute samples puts the minimum at 24 September 06:24 UT (05:56 to 07:57 UT depending on the fit window), hence the one-hour tolerance. Almanacs listing 18 September 23 UT (EarthSky, Sea and Sky) give greatest illuminated extent, the maximum of illuminated fraction over distance squared, not the least magnitude
